    MeleeWaves.crossing(MeleeWaves.Wave w, Point2D.Double p0, long t0, Point2D.Double p1, long t1)
    Where the opponent was when w reached it, given that it had by tick t1 at p1: along the straight line from its previous scan (p0 at t0) if the wave had not yet reached it there, else p0; p1 with no previous scan.
